d: A dangerous game of cat and mouse with a fleeing suspect seen with a sawed-off shotgun. A man demands codeine at a medical clinic. A husband follows his wife and her boyfriend to a truck stop.
A couple assaults a tow lot employee who won't release their car, a suspicious man catches a patrol's attention, and police detain a carload of suspected shoplifters.
Torrential rain hampers the pursuit of a fleeing vehicle, a man on a moped is carrying more than he lets on, and a persistent police officer unravels a sketchy man's story.
Fort Bend, Texas deputies arrest a man for possession of a crack pipe, and Michigan and Washington police both respond to domestic violence situations.

A pair of suspects on the run pretend they were busy napping. A man reaches for something in his pocket, but denies knowing what it is. A family calls the police after their roommate brandishes a gun.
A suspect forgets to drive away after breaking into a used car lot. A dispute over money ends in tire slashing. Suspects are found with narcotics and tall tales.
A burglar is caught hiding in a closet. A carjacking suspect gets beaten by his victim. Undercover officers bust a nervous cocaine dealer.
A young woman with warrants tries to avoid jail time, deputies confront a hit-and-run suspect, and a routine traffic stop ends with an arrest.
A teen breaks out windows when a woman rejects his advances. A sting to protect Navy sailors on shore leave for Mardi Gras. Brothers argue over cocaine use and sisterly abuse.

An officer spots a suspect returning to an area to pick up a hidden stash of narcotics. An officer learns that occupants of a suspicious vehicle has outstanding warrants. A domestic battery is investigated and justice is served.
An intoxicated cowboy promises not to drive but is caught behind the wheel. A trio steals items from a donation bin. Two brothers are caught "play fighting." A drive-by shooting is gang-related.
Albuquerque Police search for a man with a felony warrant. An ex-boyfriend bites a woman and passes out. Officers pretend to take bets while serving a search warrant at a drug dealer's house.
Cops pursue a man skipping bail, an impaired driver is surprisingly cooperative, and officers struggle to remove a violent offender from a crime scene.
